FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#defaultDbPath","claim":"defaultDbPath() returns process.env.PLAN_LEDGER_DB if set, else join(homedir(),'Documents','plan-ledger','data','plan-ledger.db')","evidence":"src/db.mjs:21-24"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#defaultDbPath","claim":"The default DB path is deliberately NOT import.meta-relative because import.meta is undefined inside the packaged SEA exe","evidence":"src/db.mjs:17-20"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store constructor","claim":"Store constructor mkdirSync(dirname(dbPath), {recursive:true}) unless dbPath is ':memory:', then opens DatabaseSync(dbPath)","evidence":"src/db.mjs:336-338"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store constructor","claim":"Store sets PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, foreign_keys=ON, busy_timeout=3000, journal_size_limit=4194304, then execs SCHEMA and runs _migrate()","evidence":"src/db.mjs:339-344"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store","claim":"Store uses Node's built-in node:sqlite DatabaseSync (synchronous API, no native deps)","evidence":"src/db.mjs:2,11"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.USER_VERSION","claim":"Migrations are gated by PRAGMA user_version; current USER_VERSION is 4","evidence":"src/db.mjs:381,383-384"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#defaultDbPath usage","claim":"Every entry point (server.mjs, web/server.mjs, web/app.mjs, scripts/runner.mjs, scripts/build-graph.mjs, scripts/seed-templates.mjs) constructs Store via new Store(defaultDbPath())","evidence":"src/server.mjs:24-25, web/server.mjs:17-20, web/app.mjs:15, scripts/runner.mjs:107-108, scripts/build-graph.mjs:10, scripts/seed-templates.mjs:5"},{"kind":"warning","subject":"src/server.mjs#comment","claim":"The header comment claims the DB is './data/plan-ledger.db next to this file' but the code actually uses defaultDbPath() (homedir Documents path), so the comment is stale/misleading","evidence":"src/server.mjs:9 vs src/server.mjs:24-25"}]
